preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 100,000.

The number of elements in set B must be between 1 and half the number of elements in array a.

preconditions.expression: all(-10**9 <= a[i] <= 10**9 for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each element in array a must be within the range of -1,000,000,000 to 1,000,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= b[i] <= n // 2 for i in range(m))
preconditions.description: Each element in set B must be a positive integer within the range of 1 to half the number of elements in array a.

postconditions.description: The output must be the maximum possible sum of all elements in array a after applying the operations.
